description: This file implements classes and methods for managing LXC containers, including network interface iteration, container lifecycle (start, stop, initialize), configuration, logging, and environment inheritance within the Thunder framework.

classes.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating network interfaces inside an LXC container, providing methods to traverse, reset, and access interface details.

classes.name: LXCContainer
classes.description: Represents an LXC container, providing lifecycle management, configuration, resource usage, and environment inheritance functionalities.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config
classes.description: Configuration container for LXC container settings, including console logging and additional config items.

classes.name: LXCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating, initializing, and managing LXC container instances within the framework.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next network interface, returning true if valid.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous network interface, returning true if valid.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator position to the initial state.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Index
methods.description: Returns the current index of the iterator.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of network interfaces.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::~LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
methods.description: Destructor that frees allocated interface resources.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::NumAddresses
methods.description: Returns the number of IP addresses for the current interface.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Address
methods.description: Returns the IP address at the specified index for the current interface.

methods.name: LXCContainer::LXCContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing an LXC container with configuration and environment setup.

methods.name: LXCContainer::~LXCContainer
methods.description: Destructor releasing container resources.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Id
methods.description: Returns the container's identifier.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage information of the container.

methods.name: LXCContainer::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CPU usage information per core.

methods.name: LXCContainer::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the container's network interfaces.

methods.name: LXCContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container with a specified timeout.

methods.name: LXCContainer::InheritRequestedEnvironment
methods.description: Inherits environment variables from host into the container configuration.

methods.name: LXCContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates and returns a container instance based on search paths and configuration.

methods.name: LXCContainerAdministrator::Logging
methods.description: Configures global logging for LXC containers.

methods.name: LXCContainerAdministrator::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the LXC library with configuration settings.

methods.name: LXCContainerAdministrator::Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the LXC library.
